1 above said case may kindly be stayed during pedency of the case, in the interest of justice."

2. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant no. 1 does not want to press the present application at this stage, and the same may be dismissed as not pressed, with liberty to file a fresh.
3. The prayer made by the learned counsel for the applicant is allowed.
4. As such, the present application is dismissed as not pressed at this stage, as far as it is related to the applicant no. 1 i.e. the husband of respondent no. 2, with liberty to file a fresh.

5. The brief facts of the case are that an F.I.R dated 05.06.2021 has been lodged by the respondent no. 2 against the applicant no. 1 i.e. the husband and the sasuralijan, alleging therein that they harassed the respondent/complainant for dowry demand.

It is further alleged that the applicant no.
1 had an illicit relation with some other woman with whom he solemnised his nikah and he had given divorce by adopting triple talak, which is not permissible in law.
6. Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that only general allegation of dowry demand has been levelled against the applicants and no specific role has been assigned to them.
4. It is further submitted that the applicants are the in-laws of the respondent no. 2 and respondent no. 2 has lodged the present F.I.R with vague and omnibus allegations.

5. Reliance has been placed upon the judgments of Hon'ble Supreme Court in the cases of Geeta Mehrotra Vs. State of Uttar Pradesh reported in (2012) 10 SCC 741 and Kahkashan Kausar @ Sonam and others Vs. State of Bihar and others reported in 2022 Lawsuit (SC) 149.
6.

7. The matter requires consideration.

8. Let notice be issued to the respondent no. 2.
9.
Steps be taken within a week.

10. List this case in the second week of July, 2025.
11.
Office is directed to submit service report by the next date of listing.
12. Till the next date of listing, no coercive measures shall be taken against the applicants.
